reviews.comment:
Mala experiencia en el Full. Primero no me cargaron los puntos por la compra. Segundo, Le pido una hamburguesa y dice 40 mins de demora. Entonces pedi el combo de mila con tomate y lechuga. Al abrirlo, se ve lo de la foto. Impresentable. Un pan quemado y una milanea sequita sequita. El ketchup es agregado mio😁. Al preguntarle a la cajera por el tomate y lechuga faltantes me dice "es que no tengo". Avisa antes, y por ahi pedia otra cosa!. El precio igual, fue "full" 🤑.
Los baños, impecables.

(Translated by Google)
Bad experience at Full. First, they didn't credit my points for the purchase. Second, I ordered a hamburger and it said there would be a 40-minute wait. So I ordered the breaded cutlet combo with tomato and lettuce. When I opened it, it looked like the picture. Unacceptable. The bun was burnt and the cutlet was completely dry. I added the ketchup myself 😁. When I asked the cashier about the missing tomato and lettuce, she said, "I don't have any." She should have told me beforehand, and maybe I could have ordered something else! The price was still "full" though 🤑.
The bathrooms were spotless.
